rows.grounds: numeral element forming the compound expression for eighty-four thousand
locative plural indicating the large number in which the diagrams are counted
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (diagram/device), denoting realms or mechanisms of birth
past passive participle describing beings subjected to affliction

items.question: What is the extent of affliction endured within the manifold womb-diagrams of existence?
premises: These womb-diagrams are loci of embodied existence.
items.inference: Embodied existence entails widespread torment across an immense multiplicity of birth-realms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
